_comment: "When this attacks, if you've been cheered this turn, create a Toughness token." The cheer check was FLAG_SET on a private CHEERED_THIS_TURN flag that no card ever set — a fourth spelling alongside CROWD_CHEERS, CROWD_CHEERS_ACTIVE and THE_CROWD_CHEERS — so it never fired. Now reads the shared cheer state via IS_CHEERED.
